reason.fx-committed: The exchange-rate commitment currently prevents an independent rate change.
reason.command-economy: The economy currently uses command allocation instead of an independent policy rate.
reason.term-cap: The rate-change budget for this term is exhausted.
reason.cooldown: Another rate change occurred too recently.
reason.delta-hike: The proposed hike exceeds the current adjustment limit.
reason.delta-cut: The proposed cut exceeds the current adjustment limit.
reason.out-of-range: The proposed rate is outside the permitted range.
reason.unknown: Current monetary policy prevents this rate change.

money.transition: The accounting method changed. Growth resumes after 12 turns measured with the same method; older observations remain historical and are not comparable.
money.legacy: Legacy accounting observation. This stock uses the previous method and is excluded from current money-growth decisions.
money.stockExplanation: M1 counts spendable account balances. M2 adds savings, NPC bank deposits, external deposits, equity market cash, and QE balances parked in the bond market. Bond-market settlement cash moves through the dealer pool without a counterparty and is reported separately outside M2. Demographic household estimates are shown separately and do not enter either total.
money.transmission: QE creates bond-market cash and supports bond prices; QT reverses this. Inflation responds to lagged M2 growth after comparable observations are available. Real growth depends on subsequent spending, investment and output and is not guaranteed.
money.cooldown: Standard cooldown: {turns} turns between monetary operations. Administrators can bypass it.
money.indicative: Indicative estimate in {currency}. Current quote and availability are rechecked by the server.
money.invalidBondQuantity: Choose an available bond series and enter a positive whole number of units within the available quantity.

centralBank.monetaryAuthority: Monetary policy is set by {name}. The national governor manages national reserves and financial accounts.

rateCorridor.credibilityNote: Credibility uses the neutral rate ({neutral}%) with inflation and GDP gaps; the prime–inflation spread above is descriptive.
rateCorridor.sharedCredibilityNote: Credibility uses the shared currency area's neutral rate with inflation and GDP gaps; the prime–inflation spread above is descriptive.

savings.holderUnknown: Savings holder could not be verified
savings.centralRateWithBonus: Half of real {prime}% prime + {bonus}% Central Bank bonus
